title: Healthy Day 5 Newborn Home Visit
story: A 5-day-old baby is feeding actively at the breast 10 times a day, crying strongly, warm to touch (36.8°C), breathing normally at 44 bpm. Umbilical stump is dry and clean.

title: Newborn Stopped Sucking Milk
story: A 12-day-old infant was vigorous yesterday but today is refusing the breast completely and has stopped sucking for over 8 hours.

title: Newborn Borderline Fast Breathing (62 bpm)
story: A 14-day-old infant is observed calm. ASHA counts 62 breaths per minute using the timer. Lungs sound congested.

title: Newborn Normal Breathing (58 bpm)
story: An 8-day-old infant has respiratory rate of 58 breaths per minute (just below the 60 cutoff). Feeds well, active.

title: Newborn Severe Subcostal Chest Indrawing
story: A 6-day-old baby has lower chest wall deeply retracting with every breath. Grunting noise heard.

title: Newborn Hypothermia (Cold to Touch, 35.1°C)
story: A 3-day-old infant feels ice cold on abdomen and feet. Axillary temperature is 35.1°C (<35.5°C threshold).

title: Newborn High Fever (38.2°C)
story: A 10-day-old infant feels hot to touch. Thermometer registers 38.2°C (>37.5°C threshold).

title: Newborn Severe Omphalitis Spreading to Skin
story: Umbilical stump has foul-smelling yellow pus and redness extending 2 cm onto the abdominal wall.

title: Newborn Early Jaundice on Day 1
story: A 18-hour-old infant has yellow discoloration visible on face, chest, and palms within the first 24 hours.

title: Newborn Mild Jaundice on Face Only (Day 5)
story: A 5-day-old infant has slight yellow sclera and nose. Abdomen, palms, and soles are pink. Feeds vigorously.

title: Newborn Sticky Eye Discharge
story: A 16-day-old infant has yellowish sticky discharge from the right eye. No swollen lids or fever.

title: Uncertainty on Convulsions / Twitching (Don't Know)
story: Mother says baby had strange jerky movements during sleep. ASHA is unsure if it was a true convulsion.

title: Lactation Difficulty and Low Weight Concern
story: Mother is struggling with sore nipples and baby slips off breast frequently. Baby birth weight was 2.1 kg.

title: Healthy 2nd Trimester Routine ANC Visit
story: A 24-year-old in her 20th week of pregnancy. Normal appetite, taking daily IFA, fetal movements good, no headache or bleeding.

title: Antepartum Vaginal Bleeding at 32 Weeks
story: A 28-year-old at 32 weeks reports fresh red vaginal bleeding soaking her clothes without pain.

title: Severe Headache with Blurred Vision (Pre-eclampsia)
story: A primigravida at 34 weeks has an excruciating frontal headache and sees flashing spots.

title: Convulsions in Third Trimester (Eclampsia)
story: A 25-year-old had a sudden generalized fit with foaming at the mouth and unconsciousness for 5 minutes.

title: Premature Rupture of Membranes (PROM)
story: At 35 weeks, mother experienced a sudden gush of clear fluid trickling continuously down her legs before labor.

title: Absent Fetal Movements at 36 Weeks
story: Mother has felt zero fetal kicks or movement for the past 14 hours despite having meals and cold water.

title: Prolonged Active Labor (> 14 Hours)
story: Labor pains began at 4 AM. It is now 7 PM (15 hours later) and the woman is exhausted without delivery.

title: Postpartum Hemorrhage (PPH on Day 2)
story: Delivered at home 36 hours ago. Currently soaking 3 cloths per hour with large dark blood clots.

title: Severe Breathlessness at Rest and Pallor
story: Woman at 30 weeks cannot lie flat on her bed due to severe breathlessness. Palms and tongue are chalky pale.

title: Mild Foot Swelling Only (Dependent Edema)
story: Mother at 28 weeks has slight swelling around ankles after walking to the field, which goes away overnight.

title: Mild Pallor and Fatigue
story: Young pregnant mother looks slightly pale on conjunctiva and complains of tiring easily while cooking.

title: Missed ANC Visits and Not Taking IFA Tablets
story: Mother is in 6th month and has not attended any ANC clinic or taken tetanus toxoid or iron tablets.

title: Healthy Toddler with Mild Running Nose
story: An 18-month-old has clear runny nose for 1 day. Eating khichdi happily, running around, breathing at 32 bpm.

title: Child 9 Months Fast Breathing (52 bpm)
story: A 9-month-old infant has respiratory rate of 52 bpm (threshold for 2-11m is >= 50). Drinks breastmilk.

title: Child 9 Months Normal Breathing (48 bpm)
story: A 9-month-old infant with cough has respiratory rate of 48 bpm (<50 threshold). Drinks normally.

title: Child 24 Months Fast Breathing (44 bpm)
story: A 2-year-old child (24 months) has respiratory rate of 44 bpm (threshold for 12-59m is >= 40).

title: Child Unable to Drink or Breastfeed
story: A 14-month-old is extremely weak and cannot take water from a cup or suck at the breast at all.

title: Child Vomiting Everything
story: An 11-month-old has vomited after every spoon of water or breastfeed for the last 6 hours.

title: Child with Generalized Convulsions
story: A 2.5-year-old had sudden stiffening and jerking of arms and legs during a high fever spike.

title: Child Chest Indrawing and Harsh Stridor
story: A 7-month-old has subcostal indrawing and a high-pitched crowing stridor sound even while resting calmly.

title: Severe Dehydration with Sunken Eyes & Slow Skin Pinch
story: A 15-month-old with 8 watery stools today has deeply sunken eyes and skin pinch on abdomen takes > 3 seconds to flatten.

title: Fever for 9 Days with Stiff Neck
story: A 3-year-old has had persistent fever for 9 days and screams in pain when attempts are made to bend chin to chest.

title: Bilateral Pitting Edema of Both Feet (Kwashiorkor)
story: A 28-month-old has visible swelling of both feet leaving deep pit impressions on finger pressure.

title: Blood in Stool (Dysentery)
story: A 16-month-old passes small frequent stools containing bright red blood and mucus with straining.

title: Persistent Diarrhoea for 16 Days
story: Child has had watery stools on and off for over 2 weeks without blood or severe dehydration.

title: Adult Mild Seasonal Cough (3 Days)
story: A 35-year-old farm worker has a dry tickly cough for 3 days after harvesting. No fever, no chest pain.

title: Severe Dyspnea and Cyanosis (Blue Lips)
story: A 52-year-old is gasping for air with a respiratory rate of 34 breaths/min and distinctly bluish lips and nailbeds.

title: Crushing Central Chest Pain Radiating to Left Arm
story: A 60-year-old male has intense chest pressure and cold sweats lasting 45 minutes, spreading into his jaw.

title: Disorientation and Neck Stiffness with Fever
story: A 42-year-old female is talking incoherently, does not recognize her family, and has a stiff rigid neck.

title: Intractable Vomiting and Prostration
story: A 29-year-old has vomited over 12 times today and cannot keep even a single teaspoon of water down.

title: Hyperpyrexia (39.6°C) and Severe Prostration
story: Temperature is 39.6°C. Patient is trembling violently and unable to sit up in bed.

title: Chronic Productive Cough for 3 Weeks (Presumptive TB)
story: A 55-year-old smoker has had a phlegmy cough for 22 days with mild afternoon warmth and weight loss.

title: Hemoptysis (Blood in Coughed-up Sputum)
story: A 40-year-old coughed up half a teaspoon of bright red blood mixed with phlegm this morning.

title: Unexplained Fever Persisting for 5 Days
story: A 31-year-old has continuous fever for 5 days without respiratory distress or vomiting.

title: Fever with Shivering Chills in Malaria Season
story: During post-monsoon season in Gadchiroli, patient has sudden rigors, severe headache, and joint pain.

title: Borderline Fast Breathing in Adult (24 bpm)
story: Patient with mild cold has respiratory rate of 24 bpm (below the >= 30 adult red-flag cutoff).

title: Unknown on Chest Pain (ASHA uncertain)
story: Patient mentions vague chest discomfort after heavy lifting. ASHA marks don't know on acute cardiac pain.
